passage:
A café street started a reusable cup system. Customers paid a small deposit, used a cup, and returned it to any participating shop.
At first, people forgot to return cups. Shops had to explain the system many times.
After clear signs and return boxes were added, the program worked better. Trash from disposable cups decreased.
Students studying the project learned that environmental habits need convenience. People may support an idea but fail if the system is confusing.
The reusable cup was not only an object. It was a network of shops, rules, washing, and trust.
Sustainability depends on design as much as desire.
